Crawl with browser mode 'always' follows links using browser rendering

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
debugPrint(result.browserUsed())
```
